meta.name: system-design
meta.description: Design scalable distributed systems using structured approaches for load balancing, caching, database scaling, and message queues. Use when the user mentions "system design", "scale this", "high availability", "rate limiter", "design a URL shortener", "design Twitter", "design Uber", "design a news feed", "system design interview", "capacity planning", or "distributed architecture". Also trigger when estimating infrastructure requirements, choosing between microservices and monoliths, or designing for millions of concurrent users. Covers common system designs (TinyURL, feeds, chat) and back-of-the-envelope estimation. For data fundamentals, see ddia-systems. For resilience, see release-it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计可扩展的分布式系统架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备系统设计面试或需要设计高可用分布式系统。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing for system design interviews or need to design highly available distributed systems.

howto.what: Claude 会按照四步流程设计可扩展的分布式系统：先明确需求，再画高层架构图，然后深入关键组件，最后讨论权衡和改进。它会估算 QPS、存储等容量，并推荐负载均衡、缓存、消息队列等构建块。
howto.when: 当你提到“系统设计”、“设计一个URL缩短器”、“设计Twitter”等关键词，或要求估算基础设施、选择微服务与单体架构、设计支持百万并发用户时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个URL缩短器，支持每天1亿次请求。
say.note: Claude 会按四步流程给出设计，包括估算和组件选择。

say.text: 估算一下100万日活用户的聊天系统需要多少服务器。
say.note: Claude 会进行容量估算并给出架构建议。
